actions.name: intel.campaign_results
actions.says: Each Taboola campaign's result over a window (today so far, yesterday, 7d or 30d, in whole days of its account's time zone): Taboola's impressions, clicks and spend; the tracker's clicks, landing page views and clicks, sales and revenue; profit, ROI and cost per sale with its likely range. Biggest spend first.

filters.says: at least this spend in the window, in US dollars
at most this profit in the window, in US dollars (below 0 is a loss)
at most this ROI, profit over spend (-0.5 lost half the spend); a campaign the tracker never saw has none

actions.name: intel.ad_results
actions.says: Each Taboola item's result over a window, compared with its campaign on profit per 1,000 impressions: step rates with their likely range, Intel's verdict (better, worse, usual, unclear, too_little) and how sure (clear, likely), and for an unclear one the spend to tell. custom_id is our ad id when Launch or Create made it. Biggest spend first.

actions.name: intel.suggestions
actions.says: Changes Intel proposes, with why and the numbers behind them: pause-ads (item_ids), pause-campaign, set-daily-cap (values.daily_cap). Intel never makes them; each is made in Launch once a person confirms it. state: open, dismissed (a person's not now), gone (the reason no longer holds) or done.

actions.name: intel.alerts
actions.says: Intel's alerts, open (closed_at empty) and closed: runaway, tracking_gap, page_gap (landing page gap), postback_gap and item_rejected, with the numbers behind each.

actions.name: intel.campaign_lines
actions.says: Campaign lines: each campaign with every campaign it continues (copied from, back to the first; depth 0 is itself). root_id names the whole line, so a moved campaign's history can be followed across ids.
